# Wien.info

> > Official Vienna tourism guide featuring attractions, museums, hotels, and the Vienna City Card for exploring Austria's capital.

Wien.info is the comprehensive travel portal for Vienna, showcasing world-class cultural institutions like the Belvedere (with Klimt's masterpieces), Albertina, and Jewish Museum, alongside accommodation options, dining experiences, and practical visitor information. The site prominently features the Vienna City Card discount program and serves international visitors with multilingual content.

## Key Topics

- Vienna City Card
- Gustav Klimt
- Belvedere Palace
- Albertina Museum
- Jewish Museum Vienna

- Boutique hotels
- 4-star hotels

- Michelin-star dining

- Eurovision Song Contest 2026
- Vienna tourism

## Major Museums & Cultural Attractions

- [Belvedere](https://www.wien.info/cs/belvedere-154646): Belvedere Palace by Hildebrandt with world's largest Klimt collection
- [Albertina](https://www.wien.info/cs/albertina-154466): Albertina museum featuring Dürer's Young Hare & world-class graphic art
- [Židovské muzeum ve Vídni](https://www.wien.info/cs/%C5%BEidovsk%C3%A9-muzeum-ve-v%C3%ADdni-155790): Jewish Museum Vienna with history exhibits & Vienna City Card discount
- [Beethoven Pasqualatiho dům](https://www.wien.info/cs/beethoven-pasqualatiho-d%C5%AFm-156362): Beethoven's Pasqualati House museum on Mölker Bastei
- [Alpská zahrada](https://www.wien.info/cs/alpsk%C3%A1-zahrada-154474): Alpine Garden at Belvedere with edelweiss & Vienna City Card discount

## Vienna Travel Guide & Homepage

- [Online cestovní průvodce Vídní](https://www.wien.info/cs): Czech homepage for Vienna tourism with Vienna City Card, events & hotels

## Dining & Restaurants

- [Amador](https://www.wien.info/cs/amador-154496): Juan Amador's 3-Michelin-star fine dining restaurant in wine cellar
- [Aux Gazelles](https://www.wien.info/cs/aux-gazelles-154598): Aux Gazelles restaurant, hammam & Turkish bath on Rahlgasse 5

## Hotels & Accommodation

- [Altwienerhof Boutique Hotel](https://www.wien.info/cs/altwienerhof-boutique-hotel-167242): Altwienerhof 3-star boutique hotel on Herklotzgasse
- [Artist Boutique Hotel](https://www.wien.info/cs/artist-boutique-hotel-167384): Artist Boutique 4-star hotel on Buchfeldgasse 8
- [Austria Trend Hotel Bosei](https://www.wien.info/cs/austria-trend-hotel-bosei-437314): Austria Trend Hotel Bosei 4-star eco-certified accommodation
- [B&B Hotel Wien-Meidling](https://www.wien.info/cs/b-b-hotel-wien-meidling-418378): B&B budget hotel in Meidling district on Breitenfurter Straße
- [B&B Hotel Wien-Stadthalle](https://www.wien.info/cs/b-b-hotel-wien-stadthalle-428734): B&B Hotel near Stadthalle on Sorbaitgasse 14

## Optional

- [Španělský kulturní institut - Instituto Cervantes](https://www.wien.info/cs/%C5%A1pan%C4%9Blsk%C3%BD-kulturn%C3%AD-institut-instituto-cervantes-156748): Instituto Cervantes Spanish cultural center at Schwarzenbergplatz
- [Alpha Sprachinstitut Austria](https://www.wien.info/cs/alpha-sprachinstitut-austria-154476): Alpha language school offering German courses at Schwarzenbergplatz 16
- [Andromeda-Tower](https://www.wien.info/cs/andromeda-tower-154508): Wilhelm Holzbauer's 113m Andromeda Tower in Donau-City
- [Austria Center Vienna](https://www.wien.info/cs/austria-center-vienna-154570): Austria Center Vienna convention venue at Bruno-Kreisky-Platz
- [Beethovenův park](https://www.wien.info/cs/beethoven%C5%AFv-park-154632): Beethoven Park public garden on Kahlenberger Straße
